description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You can combat technology with the bounty of the natural world. Attempt a @Check[nature|against:fortitude] check and smear blood, mud, or another natural substance on an adjacent creature, hazard, or item with the tech trait to disrupt it with primal energy. The DC is equal to the creature's, item's, or hazard's Fortitude DC, or the Fortitude DC of the creature attending the object. If the target is an unattended object, the GM sets the DC for the check based on the item's level. The target is then temporarily immune to your attempts to Primal Sabotage it for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 2}.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 1}.

Critical Failure The nature spirits rebuke you, causing a random piece of tech gear you own to become glitching 1.
